heroHeadline: Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-Piece Collection Drops Today; European Stadium Leg Opens Tomorrow in Barcelona — 59-Week No. 1 Record Holder Arrives in Europe
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny's landmark Zara collaboration — a 150-piece 'BENITO ANTONIO' collection named after his real name (Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio), created with creative director Janthony Oliveras — launched globally today at midnight ET via Zara.com and select Zara flagship stores (Zara Man Soho, The Grove in Los Angeles, Miami Brickell). The line spans graphic tees, vibrant bottoms, oversized essentials, caps, and textured outerwear rooted in Puerto Rican cultural identity; it was first teased at the Super Bowl LX halftime show (February 8, 2026) and debuted in a custom all-black version at the 2026 Met Gala (May 4, 'The Aging Body'). Tomorrow — May 22 — marks the opening night of the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona, Bad Bunny's first European stadium concerts in six years; both Barcelona nights (May 22–23) are sold out. On the charts, 'DtMF' holds 59 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the all-time record in the chart's 60+ year history. The Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (Vivid Red, KI7916, $120) wide release via Adidas Confirmed is nine days away (May 30). The Adidas F50 Ghost Sprint — three new World Cup colorways co-designed with Bad Bunny — is confirmed for a July 18 release. Director Residente's *Porto Rico* film (co-stars Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production with principal photography expected late 2026 in Puerto Rico.
